title: Stable-limit nonsymmetric Macdonald functions form a Cherednik weight basis of almost symmetric functions over Q(q,t)
author: Bechtloff Weising, Milo J.

original_source_record.note: Exact original numerical augmented filling only, including literal absent-cell positions. All adjacent general HHL formula, statistics and proof definitions remain editable.

difficulty_reason: The author proves convergence of appended-zero Macdonald polynomials, transports finite Hecke intertwiners to stable weights, and completes the basis through lowering and stable symmetrization. The nonzero symmetrized images distinguish partitions and prove independence inside every graded almost-symmetric component, beyond formally taking a limit.
